source: W1 production acceptance after deploy of taxila-web 9242020 (subagent), 2026-10-04; write-ups are already in context/measurements.md (no md block here, so merging does not duplicate them)

nodes.title: W1 prod acceptance on taxila-web 9242020 (n=1 run per file, sandbox, browser files routed through Node fetch): 12/13 files PASS: w0 5/5, w1a-battery 16/16, practice-ask 23/23, text-voice 3/3, young-text 14/14, w1b-mounts 54/54, tray 10/10, reteach 13/13, three-day 22/22, settle 20/20 (4 chunks), w1d-eyes 18/18, w1f-face 32/32; w1d-conductor 8/10 (no worker deployed). verify-release live-probes 10/10, prod-smoke 9/9. Leftover test guardians 7 -> 7. Product bugs: 0
Prod why-probe settle rate, 28 lessons at delays 0/1/2/4 s (8/8/7/5): 63/63 held verdicts settled = 100% (bar >= 95%, Wilson 95% LB 94.3%), 0 late-corrected; 600 s chunk fits <= 5 lessons at 4 s
Prod text-lane first audio byte from the eastus2 probe (TAXILA_PROBE=1 inside the job), n=20: p50 182 ms, p90 224 ms, bar p50 <= 400 ms PASS; streamed 20/20, prewarm hit 20/20

Running Playwright prod tests from the sandbox with Chromium on the agent proxy: net::ERR_TOO_MANY_RETRIES on random same-origin assets (curl gets 200), so browser tests hang or crash (3/3 failures unrouted, all pass routed). Route same-origin through Node fetch or run from the probe image

Prod has no taxila-worker/Conductor jobs: deploy-worker builds the moving branch tip (08e10d0: migration 019 + ~8.7k lines of server/shared/db the web 9242020 lacks); the migrations gate refused. Conductor jobs for real children stay queued until a worker is deployed at the web's sha or web+worker go together
infra/probes/deploy.mjs --adhoc forwards only TAXILA_BASE, so TAXILA_PROBE=1 on the caller side leaves the timing bar unenforced; its poller also dies on one transient ARM connect timeout

w1a-practice-ask: a waitForResponse promise created before page.goto rejects unhandled when goto throws, crashing node before withTestAccount's cleanup (leaked 2 test guardians); the global leftover-guardian count is also noisy under concurrent sessions
